title: validateCharacterDraft return type misrepresents its behavior
description: Tech-debt review finding. packages/core/src/characterCreation.ts validateCharacterDraft is typed to return a Result union but always throws on errors and only ever returns the ok-true case. The ok-false arm is unreachable dead code exported as public API. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: validateCharacterDraft either returns the Result union without throwing or its signature is narrowed to the success type with the dead arm removed from public API.
notes: PR #49 open against main: https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/49 — narrows CharacterCreationResult to the success shape and removes the unreachable ok:false branches. Awaiting review; close on merge.
close_reason: Merged in PR #49 (commit b0ecc5c) — CharacterCreationResult narrowed to success-only, dead ok:false branches removed from public API and callers.
